description: This source file defines the functionality for creating comments within the application. It includes data structures for the comment, a command for initiating creation, validation logic, and the handler that processes the creation, interacting with the database context and current user accessor.

classes.name: Create
classes.description: Contains nested records and classes related to creating comments, including request data structures, validation, and the handler logic.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the create comment command by validating, fetching related article and author, creating a comment, and saving it to the database, then returning an envelope with the comment.
